overall_verdict: All 13 numerical generated-phase values may remain. Eleven are directly supported by later visible large orbs; T9/T13 are supported as explicitly endpoint-derived generated phases using the independently reviewed normal attachments. Earlier empty/pending displays must remain separate. No unsupported numeric value identified within this scope.
phase_rules: this_turn describes a selected generated pre-attachment phase. It must not be called direct at an earlier banner, draw or previous-turn endpoint.
next describes the small upcoming preview or its explicit animation; count1 does not add to current available Energy and available remains false.
An empty large slot at the earliest inspected frame is a direct phase observation, not by itself proof of no later generation or a missed attachment.
Inactive availability null is not changed. Do not infer unspent Energy merely from an inactive empty slot.
A field-level composite can combine separate phases only when labeled. Later anchors may follow other plays; they do not certify an exact full start-board screenshot.
At F0201/F0467 generation animation limits complete simultaneous preview observation and exact availability onset. Retain explicit direct-current versus inherited/composite-preview basis.
